observations: Same saved Y,B; all conditional scores use only these and saved fitted point estimates; true P and hidden A reserved for oracle/evaluation.

construction.law: q(a) proportional to 1[a in F(Y,B)] exp(sum_(i<j) a_ij logit(Ptilde_ij)); exact block support enumeration; stable log-shift weights
construction.circular: Condition on the saved four-chain mean probability matrix, NOT mean of draw-wise conditional marginals; this is a plug-in scoring rule, not a calibrated Bayesian posterior.
construction.nuclear: Symmetric saved constrained output; off-diagonal clipping to [epsilon,1-epsilon], diagonal remains zero. Do not refit.
construction.no_selection: Report all fixed penalties and all epsilon comparisons. Do not choose based on outcomes.
construction.boundary_diagnostics: counts/min/max off-diagonal fitted values; clipped fractions by method/cohort/epsilon, especially on V; quantify changes in conditional scores and metrics
construction.numerical_ranking: Compute present and absent weighted masses separately on exact V; retain finite log-marginal-odds for stable ordering when q rounds to 0/1. Do not alter exact support or force nextafter interior probabilities.

evaluation.primary: AUC on the SAME original unresolved V; paired differences plugin-minus-raw, plugin-minus-uniform, oracle-minus-plugin
secondary: clipping-only matrix vs raw fit and conditional score, separating clipping from conditioning
stable log marginal odds ranking when probabilities round to float64 endpoints; report agreement with probability ranking and tolerance-based rankings
evaluation.units: 40 graph replicates per cohort; density settings paired by saved replicate blocks; do not pool cohorts.
evaluation.mcse: sample SD/sqrt(40), paired differences formed within graph
evaluation.ties: Primary exact numerical ties, half credit; existing corrected evaluator convention; also 1e-12 and 1e-10 tie sensitivity
evaluation.independence: Original fresh graphs independent of exploratory graphs; this added plug-in analysis is post hoc to those existing outcomes, not a new independent confirmation.

readout_correction: The primary AUC ranks float64 marginal probabilities, giving half credit for exact ties. The separate log marginal odds are retained for diagnostic comparisons.
